# comments.list — GET /posts/{id}/comments

Comment tree of a post

Returns top-level comments, oldest first. Replies are nested in `replies` at any depth.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.comments.list({ path: { id: 0 } })
res.assert(200)
```

## Input
```ts
{ path: {
  /** Post id. */
  "id": number
} }
```

## Responses
```ts
200: Array<CommentDto>
404: ErrorDto // No post with this id.
```

## Types
```ts
type CommentDto = {
  /** Comment id. */
  "id": number
  /** Comment text. */
  "text": string
  /** Id of the user who wrote the comment. */
  "authorId": number
  /** Replies to this comment, oldest first. */
  "replies": Array<CommentDto>
}
type ErrorDto = {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  "statusCode": number
  /** Error message. Validation errors (400) return a list: one message per failed constraint. */
  "message": string | Array<string>
  /** HTTP status text, e.g. "Not Found". */
  "error"?: string
}
```
